summary: Backend fully tested with pytest (22 tests): auth (register/login/me/logout), profile & stats, leaderboard, user search, friends flow (request→accept), private rooms (create/join/invite/start), matchmaking (join→bots fill after ~10s→game_id), and WebSocket game flow (bidding→playing→trick_end). Result: 22/22 pass in isolation; 21/22 pass in a full sequential run — the WS test is FLAKY (all-bots-pass rounds keep re-dealing and can exceed the 120s deadline). Backend is functionally correct. Frontend Expo web preview tested via Playwright: auth screen loads, FR/AR language toggle works, wrong-password shows French error 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect', login navigates to home-screen, 'Jouer en ligne' opens match-type sheet, choosing 'short' navigates to matchmaking and auto-transitions to game-screen after ~12s with 4 players (Tester1 + 3 named bots) and 8 cards in hand, bidding panel renders (suits + 90-160 values + Passer/Capot/Annoncer), private party creation shows room code + Partager/Inviter buttons + 4 seats + 'Lancer la partie', starting the room reaches game-screen, quit-game-button opens a Rester/Quitter confirm modal. No blocking issues detected.

minor.issue: Response includes both 'me' and 'my_rank' plus embeds 'user' data in stats; harmless duplication but consider trimming.

ui_bugs.issue: Bot avatars render as blank white circles during in-game view (names visible). Contrast with private-room screen which uses CPU-chip placeholder. Non-blocking cosmetic issue.

issues: Below the 'Jouer en ligne' card the page has a large empty region until the 'Créer une partie privée' section (only visible after scroll). Consider surfacing the create-party CTA above the fold on 390x844.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Multiple occurrences on auth screen. Reference: check Auth/home styles using shadowColor/Offset/Radius.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: one of the auth/home components uses pointerEvents as prop.

Repeated warnings: '[Reanimated] Property [transform] may be overwritten by a layout animation. Please wrap your component with an animated view and apply the layout animation on the wrapper' during matchmaking/game transitions. Reference: matchmaking.tsx / game/[id].tsx animated cards.

action_items: Optional: consider deterministic bot bidding in tests (allow forcing at least one bot to take a contract) to remove flakiness of test_ws_game when run in sequence.
Replace 'shadow*' RN style props with 'boxShadow' to silence deprecation warnings.
Wrap animated cards with an outer Animated.View so [Reanimated] doesn't warn about transform being overwritten by layout animation.
Downgrade react-native-keyboard-controller to 1.18.5 to match Expo SDK expectation (or bump the SDK).
Cosmetic: give bot players a real avatar (av1..av12) in game view — bots currently show blank white circles when rendered in the game screen.
Cosmetic: consider bringing 'Créer une partie privée' above the fold on 390x844 home layout.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (552 lines) is nearing the 700-line threshold; split auth, friends, rooms, matchmaking into routers.
GameManager stores live games in memory only — a backend restart (uvicorn --reload) will wipe active games; already known/documented but worth calling out as a resilience gap.
GET /leaderboard uses count_documents on every call; if user count grows, precompute or cache my_rank.
friends respond: no explicit check that friendship is still 'pending'; accepting an already-accepted request is a no-op but returns 200 — acceptable but note.
Turn timer of 30s for humans + auto-pass in bidding: correctly enforced server-side.

success_rate.backend: 95% (21/22 in full run; 22/22 in isolation — WS test flaky due to bot randomness)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tests rely on pre-existing tester1@belote.tn / tester2@belote.tn (auto-registered on first run). Throwaway users are created with unique emails 'pytest_<uuid>@belote.tn' for register/logout tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (currently https://card-table-orient.preview.emergentagent.com). Tests are in /app/backend/tests/, run with `cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest -v`. All WS calls MUST include a browser User-Agent header (see conftest.UA) otherwise the k8s ingress returns 403. test_ws_game is flaky in sequential runs — retry once if failed; passes reliably in isolation.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Flaky test_ws_game RCA: when all four bidders (including the human passer) pass in a bidding round, BeloteGame re-deals; if the RNG makes bots pass again the test's 120s deadline can be exceeded. Mitigation: allow the test to bid the first hand explicitly OR raise deadline OR seed the bot RNG. Since backend correctness is proven (isolation run + debug script both show trick_end/hand_end events), no server fix required.

flaky_tests.failure_mode: Never reaches 'playing' phase within 120s when every bot passes across multiple redeals.
